summaries.R6-L2: An arithmetic error on the invoice could indicate an attempt to obscure the true value of the goods. The officer could ask the customer to provide a corrected invoice.
summaries.R5-L1: Shipping goods between countries where prices are similar, especially at a higher-than-average price, might suggest an attempt to move money rather than goods. The officer could ask the customer to explain the commercial rationale for this specific trade route and pricing.
